fieldguide.entity.quark.stoneling.fine.d: Stonelings are passive mobs that appear deep underground and in complete darkness. They carry items aloft, and can be tempted with glow shrooms. To claim their item, you may resort to violence. The Heart of Diamond they drop can be used on a Stone block to create your own Stoneling!

fieldguide.entity.quark.toretoise.descri: Oretoises are neutral mobs that spawn underground. Oretoises, slowly or through the consumption of glow berries, grow ores on their shells that can be harvested with a pickaxe. Any ore can grow on any Oretoise, making them wonderful mining companions.

fieldguide.entity.quark.wraith.descripti: Wraiths are neutral mobs that spawn in Soul Sand Valleys and during Spectral Moons. They drop Soul Beads, which can point you toward Nether Fortresses.
